record.question: A newborn on Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) shows stable temperature, good feeding, and minimal apnea. The MOST appropriate action is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Continue KMC as it is. Stable temperature, feeding, and breathing are reasons to continue kangaroo mother care; current WHO guidance supports prolonged KMC for eligible preterm/low-birth-weight infants. Source/context note: KMC duration and monitoring depend on infant stability and local clinical protocol. Reference: https://www.who.int/news/item/15-11-2022-who-advises-immediate-skin-to-skin-care-for-survival-of-small-and-preterm-babies. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
